caption: Text and tool_use together. Your code reads the block, not the words.

code:
auto  -> Claude decides whether to call any tool (default)
any   -> must call SOME tool, not forced to one
tool  -> must call THIS specific tool, by name
none  -> may not call any tool
caption: "any" and "tool" pre-fill the turn — no narration text.

code:
Turn 1: user asks -> Claude replies tool_use, stop_reason "tool_use"
Turn 2: send full history + that tool_use (as assistant)
        + new tool_result -> Claude replies, stop_reason "end_turn"
caption: The assistant's own prior tool_use has to round-trip back in.

subtitle: What happens when that tool call fails.
